books.title: Your Life Is Trying To Tell You Something
books.subtitle: How to read the signals you keep ignoring
books.description: The patterns repeating in your life are not coincidences — they are messages. This book teaches you to decode the signals hiding inside your frustrations, your cravings and your quiet discontent, and turn them into a map for what to do next.

books.title: Lucky Girl Evidence Journal
books.subtitle: A 90-day guided program to prove your luck to yourself
books.description: Luck is a lens, and this journal trains it. For 90 days you collect daily evidence that things work out for you — small wins, near-misses, perfect timing — until your brain stops arguing and starts expecting good things.

books.title: 369 Manifestation Journal
books.subtitle: 90 days of the writing method that rewires belief
books.description: Write it 3 times in the morning, 6 times in the afternoon, 9 times at night. A complete 90-day guided journal built around the 369 method — with daily prompts, alignment checks and weekly reviews that keep you consistent until it works.

books.title: The Quiet Revolution
books.subtitle: Changing your life without announcing it
books.description: The loudest transformations are the ones nobody sees coming. A book about disappearing into your work, upgrading in silence, and letting results make the announcement for you.
